deploymentNotes: The primary frontend is hosted on Netlify Free, one of the hosting services explicitly named in the assessment, at an account-owned HTTPS netlify.app address. No domain purchase is required. Production is public without a Netlify login; previews remain private. The source GitHub repository is public after a full-history confidential-file and credential-pattern audit, so reviewers can read and clone it without an invitation. The GitHub Pages URL is retained as an additional fully functioning website, not a substitute for the primary Netlify deployment. Both websites passed hosted guest isolation, persistence, all seven advanced-feature categories, actual pointer moves/reordering and same-guest Realtime verification. No assessment PDF or private handoff document is published.
